label: S7-1200 CPU 1214C DC/DC/DC
description: Compact PLC (6ES7214-1AG40-0XB0) with 14 DI / 10 DO and a single PROFINET RJ45 port running at 10/100 Mbit/s - one port, no integrated switch, so it is a leaf on the plant network. Integrated web server plus OPC UA server; the RS-485 expansion module is a separate part.
